articleText: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, SpaceXAI face lawsuit over 'AI slowdown pact' Business Standard
reactions: [Hacker News] I don't think they have a dominant position. Besides that works only if you are venturing into another field while you're dominant in another.

[Hacker News] I wonder if you could pursue an antitrust cases in eu against Claude code refusing to use fable to work on some deep learning problems and downgrading to an inferior model. Would this ever be viewed as an abuse of dominant market position, aiming to disadvantage potential entrants.
[Hacker News] Ah, I see we’ve reached the point of “Don’t Look Up” where members of the public are actively mad that they’re being warned of the incoming meteor.

items.title: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, SpaceXAI face lawsuit over 'AI slowdown pact' - Business Standard
Lawsuit says Anthropic, OpenAI and others made illegal agreement on AI slowdown
